title: Classic Biome

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: To chop classic wood, rocks, and cacti, as well as to access the Classic Shop

body:
Description

The Classic Biome, also known as the Classic Island, is a remote area accessed via a the shoreline of Ferwater. The Classic Biome is a small archipelago of islands textured with classic studs. It contains classic trees, rocks, and ores, as well as an NPC that will trade Steel tools for Classic ones (Pickaxe and Axe only).

Important Locations and Quests

The Classic Biome has two notable locations. There is a noob standing in a fire ring akin to those that appear within Sword Fights on the Heights, and upon interacting with him, you can trade a Steel Pickaxe for a Classic Pickaxe or a Steel Axe for a Classic Axe.

The Classic Store is located at the back of the biome across the red bridge.

Lumberwork

Three types of trees spawn in the Classic Biome.

  • Classic Trees
  • Classic Cacti
  • Classic Purple Cacti

Mining

Two types of Stone and two types of Ores spawn in the Classic Biome.

  • Classic Stone
  • Classic Sand
  • Classic Ore
  • "Bombastic" Ore

Trivia

  • The Classic Biome was made by two members of the Discord server. If you're in the server, you can click here to see the announcement - they're credited at the end of the message.
  • Interestingly, the Classic Biome is shaped like the Linked Sword (note the curved handguard and large pommel), an item bought in the Classic Store. This could possibly link the biome to the King Statues, who all wield classic-Roblox era swords.
